witnesses: 1939 edition | manuscript (as the editors report it)
variant: Note (١) of the editors reports a marginal gloss (حاشية) of the manuscript at this place: «وان شئت قلت متى استوى المضروب والمضروب فيه كان المجتمع زائداً ومتى اختلفا كان المجتمع ناقصاً», that is, if one likes: when the multiplicand and the multiplier are alike, the product is additive, and when they differ, it is subtractive. The gloss is the manuscript's text, quoted as the edition prints it.

witnesses: 1939 edition | manuscript (as the editors report it)

witnesses: 1939 edition | manuscript (as the editors report it)
variant: Note (٤) of the editors reproduces a marginal gloss (حاشية) of the manuscript on the value of the circumference: «وهو تقريب لا تحقيق ولا يقف أحد على حقيقة ذلك ولا يعلم دورها الا الله لان الخط ليس بمستقيم فيوقف على حقيقته وإنما قيل ذلك تقريب كما قيل فى جذر الاصم انه تقريب لا تحقيق لأن جذره لا يعلمه الا الله واحسن مافى هذه الاقوال أن تضرب القطر فى ثلاثة وسبع لأنه أخف واسرع والله أعلم», that is: it is an approximation, not an exact value; no one knows the truth of it, and no one but God knows its circumference, for the line is not straight so that its truth could be found; it is called an approximation as the root of a surd is said to be an approximation, not exact, because no one but God knows its root; and the best of these sayings is to multiply the diameter by three and a seventh, because it is lighter and quicker; and God knows best. The gloss is the manuscript's text, quoted as the edition prints it.
